== f=565 citation swap ==

The members-only forum link (viewforum.php?f=565) previously used as a citation for the 11–14 August 2011 dates has been replaced with the public 2011 Worlds forum ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=626 f=626]), which names those dates and the Washington, D.C. venue. Citations on player pages for 2011 Day 2 and Day 3 decks now point at the Players Committee PDFs, with opened Wayback copies. Finish cells were not filled. == Day 2 standings ==

A Day 2 standings table (places 9–56 and Drops) and Finish cells on the 26 player pages were filled from kcaton's 14 August 2011 post in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=42393 t=42393], with Top 8 seeds from his correction in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=641415#p641415 t=42378]. Public copies: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t42393.html t=42393 snapshot], [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t42378.html t=42378 snapshot], [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t41544.html t=41544 schedule snapshot]. Ties are as posted. Players listed under Drops have no place. kcaton spelled [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] as "Matthew Harrison-Trainer"; "Eric Winings" is linked as [[Erin Winings]]; "Jan Westergaard" is linked as [[Jan Westergard]]. Day 3 knockout places were not filled from these threads; they already appear in the Results table from t=75427. Three players with Day 2 decklist rows — [[David Destefanis]], [[David Mearns]] and [[Stephen Munger]] — are not in the posted 9–56 or Drops lists.
